qa_stack.profile: there is no stack to bring up and no port to reach: run `make -C pulumi plan` from the repo root and read the plan it writes to `pulumi/preview.json`. The Makefile states the backend (a local file backend under `pulumi/.pulumi-state`) and the passphrase, so a plan taken by a check and a plan taken by a person are the same plan
fixtures: an empty local backend, which is what makes every resource in the plan a `create` rather than a diff against remembered state
a warm Go module cache and a resolvable `gcp` resource plugin — the two things a preview needs that a credential is not
qa_stack.capable_of_rendering: nothing. The program declares resources and exposes no surface; the plan JSON is the only observable this repo produces
qa_stack.notes: no credential is needed and no Google API is reached, and the Makefile is what makes that true rather than a hope: it routes the provider's phone-home attempts (an OAuth token request, a compute regions listing) into a dead local proxy. `pulumi preview` therefore emits one diagnostic warning — `failed to get regions list … connection refused` — and it is not a failure. A `googleapi:` diagnostic in `preview.json` would mean a request left the machine and was answered, which is exactly the thing to object to
